title: Owner slot 0x214 reference assignment
summary: Recovered thiscall assignment with vbtable-adjusted reference counts, release-before-store ordering, virtual deleting-destructor flag 1, null handling and identity no-op from original VA 0x490eb0 (72 bytes). Caller 0x494491 and constructor prefix 0x512f80 support the object layout interpretation.
test_description: Direct i386 original comparison across 1620 combinations of null, identity, clear and replacement, signed virtual-base adjustments and six boundary reference counts per object; compares complete owner and both pointee buffers, callback flags, adjusted this, counts and incoming vbtable. Callback checks release-before-store and mutates incoming metadata in an additional case. Installs initialized FS backing and checks restoration after every call. No actual deletion or OS services.
known_limits: Models the original 32-bit pointer layout; a 64-bit port must adapt layouts explicitly.
Class identities, unrelated fields and complete vtable signatures are unresolved. Destructor return is ignored; pointer return models the usual scalar deleting destructor ABI.
Callback fixtures validate normal-path protocol only, not real destruction, exception unwinding, invalid pointers or concurrency.
No claim of matching machine code.
